function: Possible adhesion molecule with a role in early hematopoiesis by mediating the attachment of stem cells to the bone marrow extracellular matrix or directly to stromal cells. Could act as a scaffold for the attachment of lineage specific glycans, allowing stem cells to bind to lectins expressed by stromal cells or other marrow components. Presents carbohydrate ligands to selectins (By similarity).
subcellular_location: Membrane; Single-pass type I membrane protein

properties.value: Immunoregulatory interactions between a Lymphoid and a non-Lymphoid cell
